sources.title: Statue of Liberty / Ellis Island tour candidate reviews | Exa place listing
sources.text: Busy but quite quick to get processed onto the boat, fast changeover on / off the boat. Enjoyable day trip. Needed more time to explore Ellis Island properly but that was the fault of our planning The official ferry to get you to the Statue of Liberty in Ellis Island. The hot chocolate was amazing and everyone was efficient and safe getting us over to the island despite the water being full of ice. Plenty of stating for people who may need it, and efficient at loading and unloading everyone. This is the only authorized cruise that actually takes you onto Liberty and Ellis Islands. We started around 9:00 AM, which I highly recommend to avoid the rush. The ferry from Battery Park is only about 20–25 minutes. We spent about 2 hours at the Statue of Liberty seeing the museum and the pedestal views, then took the 20-minute ferry to Ellis Island for the Immigrants Museum. Including the 20-minute ride back to Battery Park, the whole trip took about 4 hours. A must-do if you want to see both islands properly without feeling rushed! Great experience overall! Had to go security twice(booked ticketes that let us inside the base of the statue) but after that it was a great experience! The National Park officers were very pleasant. We definitely need to come back here during the warmer months cause the weather dampened our day a bit

description.value: Statue of Liberty / Ellis Island tour candidate uses Statue City Cruises, the ONLY ferry service that brings visitors to Liberty and Ellis Islands, with departures from Castle Clinton in Battery Park. All ferry tickets include access to the Statue of Liberty Museum and the Ellis Island National Museum of Immigration. Crown tickets allow visitors to access the crown of the statue, which includes a walk up 162 steps from the feet of the statue to the crown. To visit both islands in one day, the National Park Service recommends an early ferry departure. Wait time can be an hour or more during peak times, including summer, weekends, and holidays. Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “the boat ride was calm, and the views were amazing”. Representative watch-outs: “had to wait in the heat for nearly an hour for a boat”.

review2: The ride is generally calm with great views, though waits in the heat for a boat can be long in summer.
review3: Starting early is a common tip to avoid crowds, and the trip from Battery Park is short.
review4: Extra security for pedestal access is expected, but rangers are friendly and the overall experience is rated highly.
